recovered_contract: read the platform-device slot at tpd_cdev + 0xdd0
return without side effects when that slot is nonzero
when the slot is zero, load the callback pointer from absolute address 0x338
pass literal 16 through the stock KCFI-typed indirect callback
call platform_device_unregister with the value from tpd_cdev + 0xdd0, which is NULL on the observed path
interpretation_note: The null-slot unregister path is unusual and was reproduced because it is the behavior present in the supplied stock assembly. It is not a safety recommendation or proof that platform_device_unregister(NULL) is acceptable outside the original execution context.
unverified: the actual callback object at absolute address 0x338 in the running image
full module integration and boot behavior
decision_basis: Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code, Joern strict gate, reproducible Docker build, two-cycle host sanitizer harness, exact KCFI type and size, and exact normalized AArch64 instruction/relocation comparison. No smartphone test was performed.
